verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner. The box is a strong product image and the headline sits on one line with clear hierarchy. Its flaws: the lime panel runs off the right edge with uneven top and bottom margins, and the pink badge crowds the box's left edge in a way that looks accidental rather than deliberately layered. B shrinks the '48H ONLY' badge until its text can't be read, and pushes the VOLTSTRIDE box into a cramped lower-left corner so the product looks unimportant. Inside B's panel, the small three-line body copy and the button are squeezed into a narrow right column, which leaves the left of the canvas unbalanced.
